children: WINNIPEG, Manitoba--Intercontinental Exchange canola futures were stepping back late Tuesday morning, due to pressure from the speculative funds.

Liquidation pressure "The funds were so far overextended on their long position, including canola," an analyst said. "We're almost at the bottom of this. Unless there's some global bearish news, we can't go too much further on the downside." The analyst also noted the farmers have sold pretty much everything they currently plan to.
Comparable oils There were more declines in crude oil, which weighed on the Chicago soy complex, Malaysian palm oil and European rapeseed.
Weather The Prairie weather forecast for Tuesday has called for rain or snow across most of the region. Temperatures are to reach the low to mid-single digits Celsius.
Loonie The Canadian dollar was little changed by late Tuesday morning with the loonie at 71.26 U.S. cents, compared to Monday's close of 71.30.
